review_notes_and_limits: Fresh independent parent review is required before prepare, apply or stopped-hook. These tests are not approval and no mode was run.
Real parent fdinfo, manager/cgroup facts, native isolated readers, Docker image compatibility and installed restart behavior remain unexecuted; fake source proofs do not establish live acceptance.
Hook work is subject to the existing native driver's 45-second child budget and original 60-second consent; runtime fit is unmeasured and no budget is extended.

The optional models/poll inventory is deliberately omitted. Successful apply reports Core/App readiness only, preserves application-state bytes, and explicitly leaves model readiness unverified; Dev model readiness may remain false after restart.

Container and owner prefixes supplied by the task are checked with request/kind/image/log provenance; their full immutable identities are freshly captured into private prepare bindings and checked subsequently.
Image and ledger publication are not a cross-resource transaction. Failure retains phase-specific partial progress and stops without automatic Start, retry or rollback.
The previously documented broader timestamp-fixture failure is not rerun or waived by these coordinator fixtures.
